$id..validate: newData.hasChildren(['clientName','clientPhone','serviceId','professionalId','date','time','status','priceAtBooking','createdAt']) && newData.child('clientName').isString() && newData.child('clientName').val().length >= 2 && newData.child('clientName').val().length <= 80 && newData.child('clientPhone').isString() && newData.child('clientPhone').val().matches(/^[0-9+ ()-]{6,20}$/) && newData.child('date').val().matches(/^[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{2}-[0-9]{2}$/) && newData.child('time').val().matches(/^[0-2][0-9]:[0-5][0-9]$/) && newData.child('priceAtBooking').isNumber() && (newData.child('status').val() === 'pendiente' || (auth.token.role === 'admin' && auth.token.businessId === $b)) && (!newData.child('notes').exists() || newData.child('notes').val().length <= 300)
